item.title: OpenAI Ads Conversion Tracking for Magento 2 - New Server-Side Addon
item.description: The OpenAI Ads Conversions API Addon for Magento 2 is now available. It sends PageView, ViewContent, AddToCart, InitiateCheckout, Purchase and Signup events from your Magento server directly to OpenAI's Conversions API, bypassing ad blockers and browser tracking prevention for more accurate campaign measurement in ChatGPT's advertising platform. Requires Google Analytics 4 PRO 1.17.3 or higher, and is included at no extra cost in the Marketing Suite PRO bundle.
